title: 25 Years of Healing: Spandana's Journey
excerpt: From a small community clinic in 1999 to reaching over 10,000 families across Hyderabad — this is our story.
content:
In 1999, Spandana Care Aid Foundation began with a single medical camp in Secunderabad. What started as a weekend initiative by a handful of volunteers has grown into one of Hyderabad's most trusted community welfare organisations.

Over 25 years, we have conducted over 500 free medical camps, provided vocational training to 3,000+ women, and supported 10,000+ families through crises — from floods to health emergencies to domestic violence.

Our work is funded entirely by community donations and driven by volunteers who believe that compassion, when organised, can transform lives.
author: Spandana Editorial Team

title: Understanding 80G Tax Benefits for Donors
excerpt: Everything you need to know about claiming tax deductions on your donations to Spandana under Section 80G.
content:
Donating to Spandana Care Aid Foundation is not just an act of generosity — it also qualifies for income tax deduction under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

What is 80G? Section 80G allows donors to claim deductions on donations made to approved charitable organisations. Spandana is a registered 80G organisation.

How much can you claim? Donations to Spandana qualify for 50% deduction subject to 10% of adjusted gross total income.

To claim your deduction, simply request a receipt from us at the time of donation. We issue receipts for all contributions above ₹100.
author: Finance Team

title: Sahara Programme: Supporting Families in Crisis
excerpt: How our Sahara initiative provides immediate relief and long-term support to families facing domestic violence and poverty.
content:
The Sahara programme — meaning 'shelter' in Urdu — is Spandana's flagship crisis-support initiative. Launched in 2012, Sahara provides emergency financial aid, legal assistance, and psychosocial support to families in acute distress.

In 2024 alone, Sahara reached 847 families across 12 mandals in Hyderabad, Rangareddy, and Medchal districts.

Who we help: Women escaping domestic violence, children at risk of child labour, elderly individuals without family support, and families displaced by natural disasters.

If you know someone in need, contact us at sahara@spandana.org or call our helpline.
author: Sahara Programme Team
